name: Board cost
capability: Totals a count of boards from length, price per foot, and tax percent.

trigger.detail: Runs only after every figure is filled.

inputs.name: length_ft
inputs.description: Length of one board, in feet.

onError: If a figure is missing or not a number, stop and name the field. Do not guess.
script: Price {{count}} boards that are each {{length_ft}} feet, at ${{price_per_ft}} a linear foot, plus {{tax_percent}} percent tax. Lead with the total. Show subtotal and tax on their own lines.
